experiments.idea: Pre-registered follow-up to v4.1's own next step (results-v41.md: 0/32 crisp-task violations in either arm across the pilot -- the blocking mechanism was never exercised, so a null result there says nothing about D102). v4.2 measures the BASE RATE of the two crisp mistakes (D-001 CalendarRange, D-005 PulseLoader) with NO context at all (dcbench Config A: no CLAUDE.md, no Mole), 8 epochs each on TASK-001/TASK-013 (16 runs), reported as a Wilson 95% CI (stats.py's wilson). Decision rule fixed in advance: pooled CI upper bound < 20% -> dcbench cannot usefully test blocking, next step is a seeded-trap benchmark; >= 20% -> the mistake is common enough to run a powered R vs M-block comparison. Also fixes at the source (not post-hoc) results-v41.md's scorer finding that an arm's own setup files (.mole/, CLAUDE.md) can appear in the scored diff: score-v42.mjs excludes both paths from every git diff/ls-files call, identically for every arm.
